title: 'Ted Lasso' season 5 renewal has been finally been confirmed
summary: While all evidence pointed to "Ted Lasso" returning to Apple TV for multiple seasons, Apple has only just confirmed that season 5 is indeed happening. 'Ted Lasso'has been renewed for a fifth season on Apple TV. Image Credit: Apple. Following claims that pre-production would begin in January 2027, Apple has confirmed that its hit show Ted Lasso has been renewed for a fifth season. Given the success of the fourth season, which drew nearly 300 million U.S. viewing minutes across two days, it's no surprise we're getting more episodes. Back in July 2026 , Jason Sudeikis, who plays the titular Ted Lasso, said he'd like to see more seasons. The following month , Apple's own Eddy Cue similarly said the series was "certainly good enough for that," and that there were "plenty of stories to go on."
